highlights: 【Enjoy Ultimate Hi-Res Sound】Applied with LDAC audio decoding technology, UGREEN Max 6 headphones provide users with the most realistic and clear lossless sound effects. We have passed the Dual Hi-Res certification --Wired Hi-Res & Wireless Hi-Res (only a small number of sellers can obtain). UGREEN is committed to creating a top-of-the-line sound experience for every music lover and customer.

【Say Goodbye to Noise】Whether you are commuting, working, traveling, or studying, UGREEN wireless headphones can provide you with an immersive personal audio space. Our bluetooth headphones are equipped with A-level ANC technology (Adaptive Noise Cancellation) which can automatically adjust the noise reduction effect according to the noise in the surrounding environment, providing a more intelligent and personalized noise reduction experience.

【Comfortable Wear for Long Use】UGREEN noise-cancellation headphones (260g) are lighter than most headphones, which will not put too much pressure on the head when worn. The earmuffs are made of skin-friendly protein leather, which is soft and elastic, protecting your ears from damage. Max 6 headphones fit snugly in your ears, making them perfect for both exercise and long-time work.

【Ultra-long Battery Life & Fast Charging】The over-ear headphones can be fully charged in just 2 hours. With long battery life (120 hrs-ANC Off, 80 hrs-ANC On), UGREEN headphones can be used for a week after a single charge in case of frequent use and even for two weeks in case of casual use. With just 10 minutes of charging, the earphones can be used continuously for 5 hours.

【Clear and Smooth Call】Equipped with an upgraded AI intelligent noise reduction chip, the wireless headsets can effectively separate environmental noise and human voice, filter out noise, and retain pure human voice. The built-in microphone can pick up sound accurately, ensuring that you and the person you are talking to can hear each other clearly.

【Connect Dual Devices Simultaneously】With our APP, the over-ear bluetooth headphones can connect two devices at the same time, which means that you can freely switch between two devices. Note: The device dual connection is disabled by default, and users need to enable it through the APP.
【Note】The USB-C port on the headphones supports audio transmission. The included USB-C cable can be connected with other devices like mobile phones or laptops, but cannot be used for charging.
